name: Wagon Crosses Deserted Carpark
description: The wagon rolls across the empty carpark, its wheels rumbling over the cracked pavement. Dust swirls in its wake as it moves steadily through the silent, open space.
related_events: Wagon travels across deserted carpark

name: Dustcart Crew Begins Morning Collection
description: The sky is grey with the first light of dawn. A dustcart rumbles into view on a dark street, following the departure of a wagon. The crew climbs down, moves to the roadside, and begins emptying bins into the truck, loading bags and debris as the morning rubbish collection gets underway.
related_events: Dustcart crew begins collecting rubbish on a dark street

name: Dark Figure Boards Moving Wagon
description: As the wagon rolled out of the deserted car park, a dark figure leapt onto the rear platform.
related_events: Dark figure boards rear platform of moving wagon

name: Couple's Intimate Moment Interrupted by Passing Horse-Drawn Box
description: A young couple is kissing in the back of a parked car. Soft music plays on the radio. Suddenly, the car begins to shake with heavy vibrations. They pull apart, startled, and look out the window. A massive horse-drawn box looms nearby, slowly moving past them on the road. The couple watches in silence, frozen by the sight.
related_events: Young couple snogging in parked car is interrupted by passing horse-drawn box

name: Percy and Anton Open the Theatre
description: Percy and Anton unlocked the entrance and pushed open the heavy doors of the theatre, stepping inside to begin their work. Overhead lights flickered on, casting long shadows across the lobby. Outside, the mall parking lot remained lightly active, with a few late night shoppers walking to their cars, bags in hand, while others strolled past the theatre entrance, glancing briefly at the illuminated marquee.
related_events: Percy and Anton open the theatre
Late night shoppers move through the mall parking lot

name: Dr. Parnassus Sees the Woman
description: Dr. Parnassus and Percy perform on a street corner, dressed in modern clothes, their faces worn and tired like beggars. The passersby, all dressed in contemporary fashion, ignore them completely. As Dr. Parnassus looks out across the crowd, a beautiful woman comes into view. She has different colored hair and appears older than Valentina, though played by the same actress. The moment he sees her, his expression changes. He stands still, transfixed.
related_events: Dr. Parnassus and Percy perform on a street corner
Dr. Parnassus sees a beautiful woman and falls in love

name: Police Wagon Arrives at Rubbish Tip
description: A police siren wails as the wagon rounds the corner of a large rubbish tip and lurches to a halt. The horses stand trembling, steam rising from their bodies. Parts of the theatre hang loose from the wagon, broken and dangling. The siren's sound stretches into silence, fading into the distance.
related_events: Police wagon arrives at rubbish tip with horses steaming and theatre sections damaged
Police siren fades into the distance after wagon's arrival

name: Anton and Sally Cling to an Asteroid in a Chaotic Void
description: ANTON and SALLY are flung through a black void, gripping an asteroid as planets and stars spin wildly around them. Blood-red lightning bolts flash and explode in all directions, tearing through the darkness. The two cling tightly, surrounded by roaring chaos and searing light, as the void heaves them forward with no end in sight.
related_events: ANTON and SALLY are flung through a black void while clinging to an asteroid
Blood-red lightning bolts violently crackle and crash in the void

name: Valentina Startled by Mr Nick's Reflection
description: Valentina, half-undressed, struggles to remove her 'Wisdom' costume while flipping through a worn copy of 'Homes and Gardens,' studying images of elegant homes and gardens. Her attention shifts abruptly when she catches a movement in the dressing-room mirror—Mr Nick appears in the reflection. Startled, she hides the magazine and clutches her dress to her chest. She turns around, but the room is empty. 'Who's that? Who's there?' she calls out.
related_events: Valentina struggles to remove her Wisdom costume while viewing homes and gardens magazine
Valentina notices Mr Nick's reflection in the dressing-room mirror
Valentina reacts to perceived presence in the dressing room

name: George Sells Theatre Tickets at Supermarket Checkout
description: George stands in the supermarket checkout line wearing a Venice carnival mask. He chats with several middle-aged women, speaking in a smooth, flirtatious manner. He holds up the theatre's ticket dispenser and offers three tickets for the price of two. The women laugh loudly when he claims the show is much better than sex.
related_events: George smooth-talks middle-aged ladies at supermarket checkout
George promotes theatre tickets with a two-for-one offer
Middle-aged ladies react with ribald laughter to George's remarks

name: Settling Parnassus with Valentina's Command
description: Tony and Valentina move to steady Doctor Parnassus as he trembles and mutters incoherently. He repeats phrases about punishment, doom, and counting down from five, his words spilling out without clarity. Valentina hushes him gently, pressing close to soothe him. She thanks Tony and tells him to leave. He nods, steps back, and exits slowly, pausing briefly to listen before disappearing from view.
related_events: Tony helps Valentina settle Parnassus
Parnassus speaks incoherently about punishment and doom
Valentina calms Parnassus and sends Tony away
Tony exits slowly while listening

name: Valentina and Tony Carry Parnassus to His Room
description: Parnassus collapsed among the fallen scenery. The others struggled to their feet as Anton moved toward him, trying to help. Valentina pushed Anton aside, turned to Tony, and said, "What were you thinking? Look what you've done. Get out of the way!" Tony, battered and bleeding, came to her aid. Together, they lifted Parnassus and carried him into his room.
related_events: Parnassus collapses amidst fallen scenery
Valentina pushes Anton aside in frustration
Tony and Valentina carry Parnassus to his room

name: Percy Comforts Anton After Valentina's Rebuke
description: After Valentina pushes Anton aside and scolds him for his attempt to help Parnassus, Anton stands mortified. Percy approaches him and places a hand on his back, offering a quiet word of sympathy.
related_events: Percy consoles Anton with a pat on the back

name: The Hooded Rider Approaches the Monastery
description: A hooded rider moves slowly through a blizzard, guiding a horse across a vast field of untouched snow. The wind howls as the animal picks its way carefully over the frozen ground. In the distance, a monastery rises on a rugged hill, its silhouette dark against the storm. Faint light glows from a few windows. The camera glides forward, passing over snow-covered fields, dense forests, deep valleys, and jagged rocks, drawing closer to the monastery. It reaches the building, entering through a window into a dimly lit dining hall where a group is gathered, their voices murmuring beneath the distant sound of a storyteller.
related_events: Hooded Rider traverses snowstorm on horseback
Camera advances over landscape toward monastery
related_occasions: Monastery Dining Hall Gathering

name: Enter the Monastery and Join the Gathering
description: The camera passes through a dimly lit window of the monastery, high on a rugged hill, and moves into a dining hall. Inside, a group is gathered, seated or standing in quiet attendance. A low droning voice fills the space, coming from a younger version of Dr. Parnassus, who speaks to the assembly. The air is still, the light faint, as the sound of the storm outside fades into silence.
related_events: Camera enters monastery through dimly lit window
related_occasions: Monastery Dining Hall Gathering

name: Dr. Parnassus Wins the Bet
description: Dr. Parnassus and Percy travel with a small theatre, performing shows in different times and places. They invite audience members onto the stage to take part in their acts. During one performance, they make a bet: whoever can convert ten people first will win. Dr. Parnassus argues for the power of imagination and story, while Percy champions the value of material things. In the end, Dr. Parnassus succeeds in converting ten people before Percy does. He wins the bet. The victory brings him everlasting life, but also everlasting torment. Over time, audiences dwindle. People no longer come to their shows.
related_events: Dr. Parnassus wins the bet against Percy
Dr. Parnassus and Percy invite audience members to participate in the performance
related_occasions: Theatre Performance By Dr. Parnassus And Percy

name: Dr. Parnassus and the Changing Shows
description: Dr. Parnassus and Percy traveled the world with their theater, performing for audiences and inviting people onto the stage. In the 16th century, Dr. Parnassus offered everlasting life as part of the performance. By the 18th century, the show had changed, and the performance depicted everlasting torment. Over time, the crowds thinned. People no longer came to see the plays, and the stories no longer held their power.
related_events: Dr. Parnassus reflects on the changing nature of his performances across centuries
related_occasions: Theatre Performance By Dr. Parnassus And Percy

name: Percy Tries to Stop Dr. Parnassus from Jumping, Mr. Nick Saves Him with a Branch
description: On a desolate cliff top, Percy struggles with Dr. Parnassus, trying to stop him from jumping. Dr. Parnassus breaks free, stumbles backward, and falls over the edge. His coat snags on a branch protruding from the cliff face, leaving him dangling in midair. Percy screams at the sight. Below, Mr. Nick appears, holding the branch like a fishing rod, keeping Dr. Parnassus suspended.
related_events: Percy tries to stop Dr. Parnassus from jumping off a cliff
Dr. Parnassus falls from the cliff and hangs by his coat
Percy screams after Dr. Parnassus falls off the cliff
Mr. Nick saves Dr. Parnassus using a branch as a fishing rod

name: Dr. Parnassus Hangs from the Cliff
description: Dr. Parnassus falls from the cliff and dangles in midair, his coat caught on a branch that juts out from the cliff face. The branch is held steady by Mr. Nick, who stands on the edge with a wide grin. As Percy shouts in alarm, Dr. Parnassus speaks, saying that at times like these, the devil is never far away.
related_events: Dr. Parnassus speaks about the devil being near in times of crisis

name: Dr. Parnassus and the Beautiful Woman Picnic on the River
description: Dr. Parnassus and the Beautiful Woman sit together in a rowboat, sharing a picnic as they float down a river. They laugh and enjoy each other's company, their affection evident. Percy, dressed in a blazer, flannels, and a straw boater, stands at the rear of the boat, rowing steadily. The boat drifts gently, carrying them past quiet banks and dappled sunlight.
related_events: Dr. Parnassus and the Beautiful Woman picnic on a river
Percy rows or punts the boat on the river

name: Dr. Parnassus and the Floating Cigarette Butts
description: The rowboat strikes a submerged log and comes to an abrupt halt. Dr. Parnassus looks down and sees several cigarette butts drifting in the water nearby. He reaches out to push the boat free, straining against the log beneath the surface. Up ahead, a man sits on the riverbank, fishing, a cigarette between his fingers.
related_events: The rowboat collides with a submerged log
Dr. Parnassus notices cigarette butts floating in the river
Dr. Parnassus attempts to free the boat

name: Dr. Parnassus Sees Mr. Nick on the Riverbank
description: Dr. Parnassus and the Beautiful Woman float down the river in a rowboat, laughing and enjoying their picnic. Percy rows gently, wearing a blazer, flannels, and a straw boater. The boat bumps against a submerged log. As Dr. Parnassus reaches out to push them free, he notices several cigarette butts drifting in the water. He looks up and sees a man sitting on the riverbank, fishing, a cigarette in his hand. It is Mr. Nick. A loud clap of thunder cracks across the sky.
related_events: Dr. Parnassus sees Mr. Nick fishing on the riverbank
A loud clap of thunder echoes ominously

name: Don Sees the Horse-Drawn Wagon
description: Don steps outside his house with a bag of rubbish and places it in the bin. Rain glistens on the parked cars and the uneven pavement. As he turns back, he notices four large horses pulling a massive, windowless wagon down the middle of the street. The wagon moves steadily, the reins hanging loose, with no driver in sight. Don stares, frozen, then calls out to Carol inside. He shouts for her to come quickly. Carol appears in the doorway, annoyed, but the wagon and horses are already gone. She swats him with her hand and goes back inside.
related_events: Don takes rubbish to the bin outside his house
Don observes a driverless wagon pulled by four horses moving down the street

name: Don calls Carol to see the wagon
description: Don stands outside his house after taking out the rubbish. He hears something and looks up to see four large horses pulling a massive, windowless wagon down the middle of the rain-slicked street. The wagon has no driver, and the horses move steadily under their harnesses, reins swaying. Startled, Don turns toward his open front door and shouts inside. Don: Carol!... Carol! Carol's voice answers from within. Carol: What? Don: Come here! Quick! Carol: What is it? Don: Quick! Carol: I'm trying to watch this! It's the last episode! Don: Come here!!! Carol appears in the doorway. Carol: What is it? The wagon and horses are gone. Don: It's gone! Carol swats him with the flat of her hand and walks back inside.
related_events: Don calls out to Carol to come see the mysterious wagon
Carol responds from inside the house while watching the final episode of a TV show

name: Carol Misses the Wagon and Swats Don
description: Carol appears in the doorway and asks what is happening. Don exclaims that the wagon has disappeared. Carol swats Don on the head with the flat of her hand and goes back inside.
related_events: Carol appears in the doorway and asks what is happening
Don exclaims that the wagon has disappeared
Carol swats Don on the head and returns inside the house

name: Dr. Parnassus Tells the Dream of the Hooded Rider
description: Inside the monastery dining hall, Dr. Parnassus sits on a dais at the far end of a long refectory table, his eyes closed, speaking in a trance. Dozens of monks eat their supper in silence, listening. A log fire burns in the fireplace as Dr. Parnassus recounts the story of the Chief Steward, who, after capturing the wind and taming the storm, lies down to rest. In his sleep, the Steward dreams of a hooded rider approaching across a snow-swept plain—a figure that threatens the foundations of the world. Dr. Parnassus pauses, then continues, describing how the Steward wakes suddenly, remembering the dream, his mind gripped by its weight. At that moment, the refectory door crashes open. A hooded figure stands in the threshold, covered in snow. He throws back his hood, revealing himself as Mr. Nick.
related_events: Dr. Parnassus tells a story in a trance during monks' supper
Dr. Parnassus resumes storytelling about the Steward's dream
related_occasions: Monastery Dining Hall Gathering

name: Mr. Nick Arrives at the Monastery Dining Hall
description: The door to the refectory crashes open, startling the monks who are seated at the long table. A hooded figure stands in the doorway, covered in snow, the cold wind swirling behind him. The monks look up in silence as the figure steps inside and throws back his hood, revealing his face. It is Mr. Nick.
related_events: Hooded rider enters monastery dining hall dramatically
Mr. Nick reveals his identity by removing hood
related_occasions: Monastery Dining Hall Gathering

name: The Man Arrives for the Meeting
description: The Man steps into the small room before Doctor Parnassus and looks around in amazement. Doctor Parnassus gestures for him to sit down. The Man takes a seat, and Doctor Parnassus sits opposite him.
related_events: Man enters room before Doctor Parnassus
Man looks around the room in amazement
Doctor Parnassus invites Man to sit down
Man sits down in the room
Doctor Parnassus sits opposite the Man
related_occasions: Private Meeting Between Doctor Parnassus And The Man

name: The Forgotten Message
description: The Man enters a small room ahead of Doctor Parnassus, looking around in amazement. Doctor Parnassus invites him to sit, and they face each other. Doctor Parnassus leans forward expectantly. The Man hesitates, then compliments the study. Doctor Parnassus insists on hearing the message from Mr Nick. The Man admits he has lost his memory and says it will return with time. Doctor Parnassus stares in disbelief, then erupts in fury, shouting in frustration at the Man’s inability to recall the urgent message.
related_events: Man comments on the study to delay answering
Doctor Parnassus asks about the message from Mr Nick
Man claims to have lost his memory
Doctor Parnassus reacts in disbelief to Man's memory loss
related_occasions: Private Meeting Between Doctor Parnassus And The Man

name: Beauty Returns Through the Mirror and Examines Her Hand
description: Valentina, now back in the form of Beauty, steps onto the stage through the mirror. She looks down at her hand, studying the knuckles of the one she used to punch Martin. Anton watches her in silence. Nearby, Dr. Parnassus remains motionless, his lips moving without sound. Beauty lets out a sigh, then shrugs as she turns away.
related_events: Valentina returns through the mirror as Beauty
Valentina examines her knuckles after punching Martin

name: Anton Watches Valentina Return and Observes Dr. Parnassus in Trance
description: Valentina slips back onto the stage through the mirror, her costume restored to its original form. She looks at her knuckles, the hand she used to punch Martin, then shrugs. Anton turns his gaze from her to Dr. Parnassus, who remains in a trance, his lips moving silently. Anton watches him with awe. Valentina lets out a sigh, her expression one of weariness.
related_events: Anton observes Valentina in silence
Anton watches Dr. Parnassus in awe

name: Beauty Sighs in Exhaustion
description: Valentina, now back on stage as 'Beauty', examines her knuckles on the hand she used to punch Martin. Anton looks at her, and she shrugs. Dr. Parnassus remains in a trance, his lips moving silently. After a moment, 'Beauty' lets out a sigh.
related_events: Beauty expresses exhaustion with a sigh

name: Dr. Parnassus in a Silent Trance
description: Dr. Parnassus stands motionless, his lips moving without sound. The faint motion of his mouth continues steadily, untouched by the activity around him. Valentina, back on stage, glances at her knuckles, then shrugs. Anton watches Dr. Parnassus, silent and still, caught in the quiet intensity of the moment.
related_events: Dr. Parnassus remains in a trance with moving lips

name: Dr. Parnassus Drops the Paperweight as the Wagon Stops
description: Dr. Parnassus, looking worn, sways and drops the paperweight he was holding. At that moment, the wagon lurches to a sudden stop, and loud banging echoes on the roof. He turns away from Valentina, saying they’ve stopped, and picks up his Tarot cards instead of answering her. She protests, frustrated that he won’t finish speaking, but he tells her to go see what’s happening above. She leaves. Alone, he turns over the next card—The Hanged Man—and places it among the others. He takes a drink from his bottle.
related_events: Dr. Parnassus drops the paperweight while swaying
Wagon lurches to a sudden stop with banging on the roof
Dr. Parnassus avoids continuing his story

name: Valentina Confronts Her Father and Investigates the Noise
description: Valentina presses Dr. Parnassus to finish his story, frustrated by his hesitation and sudden retreat into silence. He turns away, picking up his Tarot cards and ignoring her questions. The wagon lurches to a stop. Heavy banging sounds from the roof. Dr. Parnassus tells her to go and see what is happening. She obeys, turning and leaving the wagon, while he remains behind, staring at the card he has just drawn.
related_events: Valentina confronts Dr. Parnassus about the unfinished story
Valentina responds to banging by going to investigate

name: Dr. Parnassus Draws The Hanged Man
description: After Valentina leaves, Dr. Parnassus turns over the next Tarot card. It shows The Hanged Man—his body suspended from a gibbet, surrounded by strange symbols. Parnassus stares at the image, studying it closely. He places the card carefully among the others already laid out. Then he takes a drink from the bottle beside him.
related_events: Dr. Parnassus draws and interprets The Hanged Man tarot card
Dr. Parnassus drinks from the bottle after laying down the card

name: Valentina Climbs onto the Wagon Roof on Blackfriar's Bridge
description: The wagon comes to a stop in the middle of Blackfriar's Bridge as rain pours heavily. Valentina, wearing a covering against the rain, climbs out of the hatch and onto the roof of the wagon.
related_events: Wagon stops on Blackfriar's Bridge during heavy rain
Valentina climbs onto the roof of the wagon

name: Anton Sees a Dancer in the Storm
description: The wagon sits still on Blackfriar's Bridge, rain falling heavily. Valentina, wrapped against the downpour, climbs from the wagon's hatch onto the roof. Anton stands beside her, pointing urgently at the Thames beneath the bridge. He shouts over the storm, insisting he saw someone dancing in the air. Valentina turns to Percy, who peers out from under his sou'wester, his expression grim. She looks at him doubtfully, seeking confirmation, but he slowly shakes his head. Another flash of lightning cuts through the dark. On the water's surface, a shadow appears—a figure hanging by a rope from the bridge, swaying like a dancer in the wind.
related_events: Anton points at the Thames and reports seeing a dancing figure
Lightning flash reveals shadow on the water
Valentina looks doubtfully at Percy for confirmation
Percy shakes head in disbelief

name: Valentina and Anton Discover a Man Hanging Under Blackfriar's Bridge
description: The wagon sits still on Blackfriar's Bridge, rain falling heavily. Valentina, wrapped against the downpour, climbs from the wagon's hatch onto the roof. Anton points urgently into the darkness below, stammering that he saw someone dancing in the air beneath the bridge. Valentina looks to Percy, who peers out from under his sou'wester and shakes his head. A flash of lightning cuts through the storm, illuminating a shadow on the river’s surface — a man hanging by a rope tied to the underside of the bridge. Anton cries out in triumph, calling him the dancer. Valentina stares in horror, then shouts for a rope.
related_events: Lightning flash reveals hanging figure on the Thames
Valentina reacts with horror to the hanging figure
Anton identifies the hanging figure as the dancer
Valentina calls for a rope to rescue the hanging man

name: Dr. Parnassus Confronts Mr. Nick
description: Dr. Parnassus, having removed the feed bag from the horse, recoils as he sees Mr. Nick standing behind the animal, grinning widely. Mr. Nick greets him with a mocking tone, remarking on their long separation. Nearby, Percy hears distant laughter while winding a rope around a cleat. He looks up and sees, in the distance, Mr. Nick laughing as Dr. Parnassus clutches the back of a park bench, visibly shaken. Percy moves toward them, but by the time he arrives, Mr. Nick has disappeared. Dr. Parnassus slumps onto the bench, distressed, and whispers that Mr. Nick has come to collect. Percy nods grimly and follows Dr. Parnassus’s gaze toward Valentina, who is helping to close the theatre.
related_events: Dr. Parnassus removes feed bag from horse and encounters Mr. Nick
Mr. Nick greets Dr. Parnassus after long absence
Percy hears distant laughter while securing rope
Mr. Nick laughs while Dr. Parnassus appears distressed
Mr. Nick disappears after laughing at Dr. Parnassus

name: Dr. Parnassus Confronts the Debt and Decides to Tell Valentina
description: After Mr. Nick disappears, Dr. Parnassus staggers and collapses onto a park bench, clutching the back of it for support. Percy hurries over and stands beside him. Dr. Parnassus, visibly shaken, says Mr. Nick has come to collect. Percy responds quietly, accepting the situation. Dr. Parnassus looks toward Valentina, who is helping to close the theatre. Percy follows his gaze and nods. They agree that she needs to be told the truth.
related_events: Percy approaches Dr. Parnassus as he collapses onto bench
Dr. Parnassus expresses fear that Mr. Nick has come to collect
Percy acknowledges Mr. Nick's arrival with grim resignation
Dr. Parnassus considers telling Valentina the truth
Percy agrees that Dr. Parnassus must tell Valentina

name: Parnassus Learns of Anton's Feelings
description: As Parnassus and Percy prepare to leave for a show, Percy remarks that Anton is in love with Valentina. Parnassus reacts with disbelief and anger, calling Anton a snake and vowing to skin him alive. Unseen by them, Anton overhears and winces at the outburst. Percy then shifts the conversation to Tony, describing him with scorn as a viper and an amnesiac boa constrictor, but Parnassus defends Tony, praising his ambition and energy, and notes that Valentina sees good in him. Percy counters that Valentina would be better off with Anton. Parnassus suggests offering Valentina’s hand to whoever helps win the next five souls, a comment that leaves Anton puzzled. Percy dismisses the idea, calling it worse than Parnassus’s previous ones. Parnassus sighs and admits Percy is right, expressing gratitude for his counsel. Anton, having listened in silence, moves away thoughtfully.
related_events: Anton prepares to leave with Parnassus and Percy for a show
Parnassus expresses shock at Anton's love for Valentina
Anton moves away thoughtfully after the discussion
related_occasions: Doctor Parnassus'S Travelling Theatre Performance

name: Percy Warns Parnassus About Tony
description: Parnassus wonders what is troubling Anton, and Percy suggests he is in love with Valentina. Startled, Anton listens from nearby. Parnassus reacts with outrage, threatening to punish Anton. Percy redirects his attention, urging him not to overlook a greater threat—Tony. He describes Tony with sharp metaphors, calling him a viper, a scorpion, and an amnesiac boa constrictor. Parnassus defends Tony, praising his ambition and energy, and insists he is different from Anton. Percy responds with irony, questioning how Tony will help them win the next five souls. Parnassus proposes offering Valentina’s hand in marriage to whoever contributes most to winning those souls. Anton, overhearing, looks confused. Percy dismisses the idea as worse than Parnassus’s previous ones. Parnassus sighs and admits Percy is right, then muses about what he would do without him. Percy replies, 'Get a midget.' Anton, deep in thought, quietly moves away.
related_events: Percy reveals Tony as another hidden threat
Parnassus proposes offering Valentina's hand in marriage to the one who helps win five souls
related_occasions: Doctor Parnassus'S Travelling Theatre Performance

name: Parnassus Proposes a Marriage Contest
description: Dr. Parnassus suggests offering Valentina's hand in marriage to whoever helps win the next five souls. Anton, overhearing, looks puzzled by the idea. Percy immediately dismisses the proposal, calling it worse than Parnassus's other recent ideas. Parnassus sighs and admits Percy is right, abandoning the suggestion. The moment passes as Anton moves away, deep in thought.
related_events: Anton reacts with puzzlement to Parnassus's marriage proposal idea
Percy criticizes Parnassus's proposal as worse than previous ideas
related_occasions: Doctor Parnassus'S Travelling Theatre Performance

name: Anton Walks into the Surreal Landscape
description: Anton moves through cut-out trees and steps into a brightly colored, fantastical landscape of twisting hills and valleys that resemble the work of Dr. Seuss. The sky is filled with large, cloud-sized soap bubbles floating gently through the air. In the distance, Diego stands with a game controller, directing the bubbles to collide and burst. As Anton takes in the scene, cracks begin to spread across the ground beneath his feet.
related_events: Anton walks into surreal Dr. Seuss-like landscape
Cracks form in ground beneath Anton's feet

name: Diego Plays with Bubbles in the Dreamscape
description: In the surreal, brightly colored landscape, Diego stands in the distance, holding a game controller. He guides the movement of giant soap bubbles floating in the sky, steering them into collisions with one another. One by one, the bubbles burst upon impact, scattering shimmering droplets into the air. Around him, the ground begins to crack beneath Anton’s feet, while the sky swirls with the remnants of the broken bubbles.
related_events: Diego uses game controller to collide soap bubbles

name: Dr. Parnassus' Outburst Tears the Landscape Apart
description: Dr. Parnassus lets out a furious scream, and the surreal landscape shudders violently. The ground and sky split open, tearing into jagged fragments as the hills, valleys, and floating soap bubbles begin to spin wildly. Anton is caught inside the collapsing world, unable to escape as pieces of the environment break apart and fly in all directions.
related_events: Dr. Parnassus' rage causes landscape to rip apart
Objects scatter as landscape disintegrates

name: Valentina's Pitch Amid Chaos
description: Valentina speaks urgently, her voice rising over the noise of a wailing baby. Around her, the family grows more agitated, shouting names—Diego, Degsy—while she presses on, declaring that beauty, truth, wisdom, and justice mean nothing without imagination. Her words echo as the ground beneath Anton cracks and the sky of floating soap bubbles shudders, then tears apart.
related_events: Valentina continues pitch amid disruptive family

name: Anton Begins the Imaginarium Performance
description: Anton steps forward and speaks in a low, steady voice, addressing the unseen audience. 'For one night only... raise your sights... encounter the majesty, the beauty, the miracle that's in each and every one of you. Take this opportunity to expand your horizons. It's not too late. Experience the Imaginarium of the great Doctor Parnassus.' As he speaks, Percy stands nearby, dressed in a medieval one-man-band outfit, quietly playing his instruments to create a faint, otherworldly soundtrack. Above them, Doctor Parnassus hovers motionless on his glass pillar, eyes closed, humming softly at irregular intervals, seemingly unaware of his surroundings. Valentina and Anton remain close to him, ready to steady him should he shift or fall.
related_events: Anton begins performance to introduce the Imaginarium
Percy performs as one-man band in medieval costume
Doctor Parnassus floats on glass pillar in trance-like state
related_occasions: The Astonishing Imaginarium Of Doctor Parnassus Performance

name: Valentina and Anton Stand By Parnassus
description: Valentina and Anton stay close to Doctor Parnassus as he floats on the glass pillar, his body swaying slightly while he hums in a trance. They watch him carefully, their hands ready to catch him should he lose balance. Around them, the stage remains tense and still, the performance hanging in the air as they wait for the next move.
related_events: Valentina and Anton stand by Doctor Parnassus for support
related_occasions: The Astonishing Imaginarium Of Doctor Parnassus Performance

name: Valentina Searches for George While Anton Jokes
description: Valentina scans the shadows beyond the stage, her eyes moving restlessly over the dark spaces where the audience should be, searching for George. She frowns, her voice tense as she says, 'Where's George? He's nowhere in sight.' Anton, standing near the floating glass pillar where Doctor Parnassus hovers in silence, replies with a smirk, 'Probably remembered he had a wife or two back in Russia.' Valentina turns to him, her expression sharp and unamused, then looks away without speaking, her focus returning to the empty spaces beyond the stage.

He realizes the story doesn’t depend on them alone—somewhere in the world, someone is always telling a story. That, he says, is why the universe remains. With a smirk, he releases the spell. The monks gasp, their voices returning, but Dr. Parnassus slumps to the ground, defeated. Mr. Nick lights a cigarette, exhales slowly, and suggests they travel, learn languages, or amuse themselves. An eagle suddenly swoops through the hall, leaving a trail of droppings on Mr. Nick’s head before vanishing through a window. Dr. Parnassus leaps to his feet, laughing, his eyes wide with realization.

He proclaims that stories are being told somewhere in the world at every moment, and that this is what sustains the universe. name: Anton's Pitch Undermined by Tony's Charm
description: Anton, dressed as Mercury, stands on stage delivering a passionate pitch, urging the passersby to embrace the once-in-a-lifetime journey into the imagination guided by Doctor Parnassus. Behind the curtain, Percy signals to Valentina, who checks whether Doctor Parnassus has been drinking. The doctor snaps at her to concentrate as Percy begins a roll on the drums and the curtain rises, revealing Doctor Parnassus floating above the stage on his glass plinth. Anton proclaims the doctor’s ancient wisdom and mystical powers, but the small crowd—mostly drinkers stepping out of the pub for a smoke—pays little attention. Instead, their eyes turn to Tony, who moves through the audience in a striking costume, smiling and joking with effortless charm. He draws a group of women around him, including a young woman named Sally, who laughs at his jokes and gazes at him with clear admiration. Tony locks eyes with her, smiling seductively. Seeing this, Anton grows agitated. He leaps off the stage, strides over, and grabs Sally by the wrist, pulling her toward the performance area. Percy continues playing. Sally resists playfully, laughing and asking what he is doing. Anton insists she will not regret it. Her friend encourages her to go, and when Sally says her friend must come too, the friend eagerly agrees. A few onlookers cheer. Anton refuses, stammering that two imaginations cannot enter the Imaginarium at once—the stronger would overwhelm the weaker, with unpredictable consequences. The friend calls it stupid. Sally demands to be let go. Anton insists she has nothing to fear. As Valentina steps forward, concerned, Anton sweeps Sally into his arms and carries her onto the stage. She struggles and shouts for him to put her down. Her friend yells that Sally doesn’t want to go alone and calls Anton a fool. Valentina tries to intervene, calling his name, but Anton pushes forward, stumbling into Doctor Parnassus’ glass plinth. It rocks violently and crashes to the stage, the doctor falling headfirst with a loud crack. Valentina rushes to him as he lies dazed, clutching his head. From behind the mirror, a woman’s scream pierces the air—terrified and piercing. The friend screams that they’ve got Sally and something is happening to her, shouting for help.

name: The Wagon Unfolds into the Imaginarium Stage
description: The wagon comes to a halt, and its back begins to open—top, bottom, and sides—like a dark flower unfolding. Shadowy figures work the panels, lifting the roof as the structure transforms into a worn, old-fashioned travelling theatre. A clanking generator powers electric footlights along the stage, casting a garish glow. Across the street, a group of drunken youths stumbles out of a club, laughing and breaking bottles, when they notice the unfolding spectacle. They stop, swaying, as the full stage is revealed. A dwarf named Percy, dressed as a demon and rigged as a one-man band, plays a fanfare. From the back of the stage steps Anton, a young man in the costume of Mercury, complete with winged helmet and sandals. He calls out to the crowd, inviting them to witness the mind of Doctor Parnassus. Behind him, a curtain rises to reveal Doctor Parnassus himself—bearded, pale-faced, crowned with yellow flowers, seated on a glass plinth that gives the illusion of levitation. Incense burns beside him in a bronze tripod. Valentina, dressed as Beauty with flowing blonde hair and a white, ethereal costume, steps forward from behind cut-out trees and takes Anton’s hand. They dance lightly together. Percy suddenly leaps forward, pointing to a ticket dispenser on the stage. He urges the onlookers to take a ticket and join the queue. The youths watch, some jeering, as a beer bottle lands on the stage. Anton glances at them, then continues, offering a choice: transcendence on Beauty’s wing, or the descent into darkness with Stench, Percy’s grotesque alter ego.

name: Martin's Drunken Assault on the Stage
description: Martin, egged on by his laughing friends, stumbles toward the stage and attempts to climb onto it without taking a ticket. Anton steps forward and blocks his way, speaking firmly, no longer in character. Martin shoves him, knocking him off the stage and into the crowd. The onlookers, including Martin's mates, erupt in laughter and applause. Percy rushes in to intervene but is violently shoved aside and falls to the ground. The crowd mocks his fall. Martin strides across the stage toward Doctor Parnassus, who remains seated in silence, eyes closed, seemingly unaware. Standing before him, Martin slurs his words and loudly declares his intention to audition, swaying unsteadily under the harsh stage lights.

name: Valentina Flees Through the Mirror to Escape Martin's Advance
description: Martin staggers toward Valentina, shouting a crude comment about her appearance. He lunges at her, but she steps back, demanding he leave the stage. She turns and ducks behind the full-length mirror nestled among the cut-out trees. Martin stumbles after her, blunders into the scenery, and crashes through the mirror in pursuit. Valentina is no longer visible on the stage. Anton and Percy exchange worried glances, then look toward Doctor Parnassus, who remains seated on the glass plinth, eyes closed, seemingly in a trance. They hesitate, then decide not to disturb him.
